'''Almere City Football Club''' is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Almere]], Netherlands. While the current organization was founded in 2001, it has roots dating back to 1959. The club currently compete in the [[Eerste Divisie]], following relegation from the [[Eredivisie]] in [[2024–25 Eredivisie|2024–25]]. They play their home matches at the 4,501-capacity [[Yanmar Stadion|Yanmar Hanasaka Stadion]].

The club builds on former clubs from [[Amsterdam]] and is a result of ambitions of the [[Almere]] city council to play an active role in top sports. To that end, the sports club ''Omniworld'' was formed, which consisted of a [[volleyball]] branch, a [[basketball]] branch and a football branch. Prior to the [[2010–11 Eerste Divisie|2010–11 season]], the club was renamed to Almere City FC."}}
